product_brief: Network operating system platform for HPE Aruba Networking infrastructure.
pqc_capability_description: The document outlines a proposed amendment to IEEE 802.1AR-2018 to add support for Post-Quantum Cryptography, specifically recommending the addition of ML-DSA (Dilithium) OIDs in ITU-T X.509 certificate formats. It explicitly recommends against adding SPHINCS+ or LMS/XMSS.
key_management_model: DevID module key generation using RNG with sufficient entropy; TPM1.2 and TPM2.0 provisioning referenced.
fips_validated: References NIST FIPS 180-4 and FIPS-204; no specific FIPS 140 validation status stated for the product itself.
pqc_roadmap_details: Proposal to add ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 to 802.1AR-2018; recommends ML-DSA-87 for government agencies; excludes SPHINCS+ and LMS/XMSS.
implementation_attack_surface: Mentions consideration of mitigation against algorithm downgrade attacks.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: RNG used by DevID module must have sufficient entropy for at least 128-bit (RSA) or 256-bit (ML-DSA) security strength.
